name: Magento
label: Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce REST V1
description: Magento Open Source / Adobe Commerce REST /rest/V1. Customer create/update take email, firstname, lastname (nested under customer) plus optional password. Product create/update take sku, name, price, status, type_id. Docs: https://developer.adobe.com/commerce/webapi/rest/. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: customer_create | customer_get | customer_list | customer_update | customer_delete | invoice_create | order_cancel | order_get | order_list | order_ship | product_create | product_get | product_list | product_update | product_delete. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Customer or order id for get/update/delete/cancel. Example: 3.

schema.label: searchCriteria[pageSize]
schema.description: Magento searchCriteria[pageSize] query for customer_list, order_list, product_list. Example: 20.

schema.label: orderId
schema.description: Order id for invoice_create and order_ship. Example: 12.

schema.label: sku
schema.description: Product SKU. Path for product_get/update/delete; also product.sku on create/update. Example: 24-MB01.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Customer email. Wired to customer.email on customer_create / customer_update. Example: jane@example.com.

schema.label: firstname
schema.description: Customer first name. Wired to customer.firstname. Example: Jane.

schema.label: lastname
schema.description: Customer last name. Wired to customer.lastname. Example: Doe.

schema.label: password
schema.description: New customer password (customer_create only). Official top-level password. Never log.

schema.label: store_id
schema.description: Store view id. Wired to customer.store_id. Example: 1.

schema.label: website_id
schema.description: Website id. Wired to customer.website_id. Example: 1.

schema.label: addresses
schema.description: Customer addresses array. Wired to customer.addresses. Official Magento address objects.

schema.label: customer
schema.description: Customer envelope escape hatch for customer_create/update. Purpose fields email/firstname/lastname/store_id/website_id/addresses merge as customer.* via bodyMap. password stays at the JSON root.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Product name. Wired to product.name on product_create / product_update. Example: Watch.

schema.label: price
schema.description: Product price. Wired to product.price. Example: 19.99.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Product status. Wired to product.status. EXACT: 1 enabled | 2 disabled.

schema.label: type_id
schema.description: Product type. Wired to product.type_id. Typical: simple | configurable | virtual | downloadable. Example: simple.

schema.label: attribute_set_id
schema.description: Attribute set id. Wired to product.attribute_set_id. Example: 4.

schema.label: weight
schema.description: Product weight. Wired to product.weight.

schema.label: product
schema.description: Product envelope escape hatch for product_create/update. Purpose fields sku/name/price/status/type_id/attribute_set_id/weight merge as product.* via bodyMap.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: customer_create | customer_get | customer_list | customer_update | customer_delete | invoice_create | order_cancel | order_get | order_list | order_ship | product_create | product_get | product_list | product_update | product_delete. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type bearer. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
